How it works
  • Add your local gas price or an EIA API key for live prices
  • Add up to six vehicles — set the fuel type so live prices apply correctly
  • Click a vehicle card to select it as your active vehicle
  • Open Google Maps and get directions — trip cost and CO₂ appear next to each route's distance
  • Use the round trip toggle in the popup to double the estimate
This will permanently delete all your saved vehicles and settings.
